name: Serena Bloodfeather
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.

narrative.details:
You did so well with the lieutenants and underlings that I'd like you to do one last thing for me.

Serena Bloodfeather is the sister of a harpy named Bloodfeather who was slain by Rexxar quite a while ago. Apparently, these attacks on the Horde caravans are revenge for her sister's death.

I need you to slit her throat and bring me back her head. I want to place it on the next caravan we send out... Give those harpies something to think about.
narrative.objectives: Slay Serena Bloodfeather and return her head to Darsok Swiftdagger at the Crossroads.
narrative.offerRewardText: HA! Well done, adventurer! Very well done... I wasn't sure you were up to the task, but you've proved yourself quite the cut-throat. Thank you again for helping us suppress the Harpy epidemic. Here is your reward, use it well.
narrative.requestItemsText: You're not getting anything until I see Serena's head.

chain.subtitle: 4 quests from level 15 to 20, 5,700 XP in all.

quests.name: Harpy Raiders
quests.objectiveText: Collect 8 Witchwing talons. Return them to Darsok Swiftdagger at the Crossroads.

quests.name: Harpy Lieutenants
quests.objectiveText: Collect 6 Harpy Lieutenant Rings from Witchwing Slayers and return them to Darsok Swiftdagger at the Crossroads.

quests.name: Serena Bloodfeather
quests.objectiveText: Slay Serena Bloodfeather and return her head to Darsok Swiftdagger at the Crossroads.

quests.name: Letter to Jin'Zil
quests.objectiveText: Deliver Darsok's letter to Jin'Zil within his cave in Malaka'Jin, in Stonetalon.
